events.title: Lower Palaeolithic: earliest stone tools
events.summary: Earliest hand-axes and choppers of the Quartzite Men (Soan valley, Bhimbetka).
events.detail:
Lower Palaeolithic humans used hand-axes, cleavers and choppers; no pottery, agriculture or metals.

**Exam hooks:** John Lubbock coined "Palaeolithic" (1865); R.B. Foote found the Pallavaram hand-axe (1863); Bhimbetka rock shelters are UNESCO-listed.

events.title: Mesolithic microliths & Bhimbetka art
events.summary: Microlithic tools and the earliest rock paintings; beginnings of domestication.
events.detail:
Holocene Mesolithic (c.9000–4000 BCE): tiny microliths, hunting-gathering shifting to domestication (Adamgarh, Bagor).

**Exam hooks:** first animal domesticated = dog; Bhimbetka paintings; earliest human burials (Damdama).

events.title: Neolithic Mehrgarh: earliest farming
events.summary: Mehrgarh — oldest farming and animal-domestication settlement in the subcontinent.
events.detail:
Neolithic (New Stone Age): polished tools, wheel, agriculture. Mehrgarh (c.7000 BCE) is the oldest.

**Exam hooks:** Burzahom pit-dwellings & dog burials; Chirand bone tools; South-Indian Neolithic ash-mounds.

events.title: Chalcolithic (Copper–Stone) village cultures
events.summary: First metal (copper) use; Ahar, Kayatha, Malwa and Jorwe farming cultures.
events.detail:
Chalcolithic (c.3500–1000 BCE): Black-and-Red Ware, jhum, first use of copper.

**Exam hooks:** Ahar-Banas, Kayatha, Malwa, Savalda, Jorwe, Prabhas-Rangpur; social inequality emerges.

events.title: Early Harappan (Ravi/Hakra) phase begins
events.summary: Pre-urban farming communities on the Indus–Ghaggar plains.
events.detail:
The formative phase before the mature cities; regionalisation of pottery and craft.

**Exam hooks:** IVC span c.3300–1300 BCE; part of the Bronze Age; contemporary of Mesopotamia & Egypt.

events.title: Mature Harappan: planned cities
events.summary: Urban peak — grid cities, drainage, granaries, seals and the undeciphered script.
events.detail:
Harappa (John Marshall/Daya Ram Sahni, 1921) & Mohenjo-daro (R.D. Banerji, 1922) show grid planning and the Great Bath.

**Exam hooks:** Lothal dockyard, Dholavira water-management & signboard, Kalibangan ploughed field, standardised weights (16-ratio).

events.title: Late Harappan: de-urbanisation
events.summary: Cities decline — river shifts, floods, ecological and trade factors.
events.detail:
Gradual abandonment of the great cities; continuity into rural late-Harappan cultures.

**Exam hooks:** no single cause; Aryan-invasion theory now largely rejected as the explanation.

events.title: Rig Veda composition begins
events.summary: Early Vedic (Rig Vedic) society on the Sapta-Sindhu; the oldest Veda is composed.
events.detail:
Pastoral, tribal (jana) society; cattle (gau) as wealth; Indra, Agni, Varuna worshipped.

**Exam hooks:** Rig Veda = oldest text; Gayatri mantra (to Savitri); Sapta-Sindhu = land of seven rivers.

events.title: Later Vedic Age: iron & eastward move
events.summary: Iron (krishna-ayas), settled agriculture and the move to the Ganga plains.
events.detail:
Rise of janapadas, varna hierarchy hardens, Painted Grey Ware culture.

**Exam hooks:** later Vedic texts = Samhitas, Brahmanas, Aranyakas, Upanishads; "Satyameva Jayate" from Mundaka Upanishad.

events.title: Sixteen Mahajanapadas emerge
events.summary: Second urbanisation — 16 great states; punch-marked coins and republics.
events.detail:
Buddhist Anguttara Nikaya and Jaina Bhagavati Sutra list the 16 mahajanapadas.

**Exam hooks:** Magadha, Kosala, Vatsa, Avanti = four most powerful; Vajji = republic (gana-sangha).

events.title: Birth of Mahavira (24th Tirthankara)
events.summary: Vardhamana Mahavira, who systematised Jainism, is born at Kundagrama.
events.detail:
Attained kaivalya; preached the Three Jewels (Right faith, knowledge, conduct) and five vows.

**Exam hooks:** 23rd Tirthankara = Parshvanatha; Jain councils at Pataliputra & Valabhi; sects Digambara/Svetambara.

events.title: Birth of Gautama Buddha at Lumbini
events.summary: Siddhartha Gautama born at Lumbini to the Shakya clan.
events.detail:
Later renounced (Mahabhinishkramana), attained enlightenment and founded Buddhism.

**Exam hooks:** birth = Lumbini; symbol = lotus/bull; the Four Sights prompt renunciation.

events.title: Bimbisara founds Magadha ascendancy (Haryanka)
events.summary: Haryanka dynasty under Bimbisara begins the rise of imperial Magadha.
events.detail:
Bimbisara used marriage alliances and conquest (Anga); Ajatashatru succeeded via patricide.

**Exam hooks:** capital Rajgir (Girivraja), later Pataliputra; contemporaries of Buddha & Mahavira.

events.title: Buddha's enlightenment at Bodh Gaya
events.summary: Attains Nirvana under the Bodhi tree; first sermon at Sarnath (Dharmachakra-pravartana).
events.detail:
Preached the Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path; Middle Path between extremes.

**Exam hooks:** enlightenment = Bodh Gaya; first sermon = Sarnath; symbol = wheel/Bodhi tree.

events.title: Mahaparinirvana of the Buddha; First Council
events.summary: Buddha dies at Kushinagar; First Buddhist Council held at Rajgir.
events.detail:
The First Council (under Ajatashatru) compiled the Sutta & Vinaya Pitakas.

**Exam hooks:** Four Councils — Rajgir, Vaishali, Pataliputra (Ashoka), Kashmir (Kanishka); Tripitakas in Pali.

events.title: Second Buddhist Council at Vaishali
events.summary: Schism into Sthaviravadins & Mahasanghikas over monastic rules.
events.detail:
A century after the Buddha's death.

**Exam hooks:** Second Council → early sectarian split.

events.title: Mahapadma Nanda founds the Nanda dynasty
events.summary: First non-Kshatriya empire-builders; vast army noted by Greek sources.
events.detail:
Dhana Nanda was the last; his unpopularity aided Chandragupta Maurya.

**Exam hooks:** Nandas precede the Mauryas; huge standing army deterred Alexander east of the Beas.

events.title: Alexander's invasion; Battle of Hydaspes
events.summary: Alexander defeats Porus on the Jhelum (Hydaspes) but retreats at the Beas.
events.detail:
Opened India–West contact; his retreat left a power vacuum in the north-west.

**Exam hooks:** Porus (Purushottama); admiral Nearchus; Alexander died at Babylon 323 BCE.

events.title: Chandragupta Maurya founds the Mauryan Empire
events.summary: With Chanakya (Kautilya), Chandragupta overthrows the Nandas — India's first pan-Indian empire.
events.detail:
Kautilya's Arthashastra is the classic treatise on statecraft; capital Pataliputra.

**Exam hooks:** Chandragupta later turned Jain (Sravanabelagola with Bhadrabahu).

events.title: Chandragupta defeats Seleucus; treaty
events.summary: Seleucus cedes the trans-Indus provinces; Megasthenes sent as envoy.
events.detail:
Marriage alliance and 500 war-elephants; secured the north-west frontier.

**Exam hooks:** Megasthenes wrote the Indica (Pataliputra society, administration).

events.title: Jain councils & split (Digambara/Svetambara)
events.summary: First Jain Council at Pataliputra; sectarian split over practice.
events.detail:
Second council at Valabhi finalised the canon.

**Exam hooks:** Digambara (sky-clad) vs Svetambara (white-clad).

events.title: Sangam Age: Tamil academies at Madurai
events.summary: Cheras, Cholas and Pandyas; the earliest Tamil literature.
events.detail:
Three Sangams under Pandya patronage; Tolkappiyam is the oldest Tamil grammar.

**Exam hooks:** Muvendar = three crowned kings; emblems — Chera(bow), Chola(tiger), Pandya(fish).

events.title: Ashoka ascends the Mauryan throne
events.summary: Ashoka, the greatest Mauryan, begins his reign (c.268 BCE).
events.detail:
His edicts (Brahmi, Kharoshthi, Greek, Aramaic) are the first decipherable Indian records.

**Exam hooks:** James Prinsep deciphered Brahmi; Dhamma Mahamatras; capital Sarnath Lion = national emblem.

events.title: Kalinga War; Ashoka embraces Buddhism
events.summary: Bloodshed at Kalinga turns Ashoka to Buddhism and the policy of Dhamma.
events.detail:
Described in the 13th Major Rock Edict; he sent missions (incl. son Mahendra & daughter Sanghamitra to Sri Lanka).

**Exam hooks:** the ONLY war Ashoka fought; renounced Bherighosha for Dhammaghosha.

events.title: Ashokan Mauryas reach the Andhra country
events.summary: Mauryan influence extends into Andhra; Ashokan edicts & early Buddhism in the region.
events.detail:
Buddhism took deep root in coastal Andhra before the Satavahanas.

**Exam hooks:** Andhra Buddhist sites — Amaravati, Bhattiprolu, Ghantasala.

events.title: Ashokan pillars & Sarnath capital
events.summary: Polished sandstone pillars; the Sarnath Lion Capital is the national emblem.
events.detail:
Mauryan art's finest achievement.

**Exam hooks:** Sarnath Lion Capital → State Emblem; Dhamma Chakra on the flag.

events.title: Third Buddhist Council under Ashoka
events.summary: At Pataliputra (Moggaliputta Tissa); missionaries sent abroad.
events.detail:
Compiled the Abhidhamma Pitaka.

**Exam hooks:** Third Council → Buddhism spreads to Sri Lanka (Mahendra).

events.title: Death of Ashoka; Mauryan decline
events.summary: Empire fragments after Ashoka; ends with Brihadratha in 185 BCE.
events.detail:
Weak successors, financial strain and provincial revolts caused decline.

**Exam hooks:** last Mauryan Brihadratha killed by Pushyamitra Shunga (185 BCE).

events.title: Simuka founds the Satavahana dynasty
events.summary: The Satavahanas (Andhras) rise in the Deccan — the earliest Andhra imperial power.
events.detail:
Capital Pratishthana (Paithan); issued lead & potin coins; patronised Prakrit and Buddhism.

**Exam hooks:** Puranas call them "Andhras"; matrilineal naming (Gautamiputra).

events.title: Bhattiprolu casket & Brahmi variant
events.summary: Buddhist relic casket at Bhattiprolu (Guntur) with an early Brahmi variant.
events.detail:
Among the earliest inscriptions of coastal Andhra.

**Exam hooks:** Bhattiprolu script — a southern Brahmi variant.

events.title: Pushyamitra Shunga founds the Shunga dynasty
events.summary: End of the Mauryas; Shunga revival of Brahmanism and Sanskrit.
events.detail:
Patanjali's Mahabhashya and the Bharhut stupa railings belong to this age.

**Exam hooks:** Shungas → Kanvas (Vasudeva); Kalidasa's Malavikagnimitra is set here.

events.title: Indo-Greek invasions of the north-west
events.summary: Demetrius/Menander rule the north-west; first gold coins & Gandhara contact.
events.detail:
Menander (Milinda) debated the monk Nagasena (Milindapanho).

**Exam hooks:** Indo-Greeks issued the first coins with royal portraits and legible names.

events.title: Vikrama Samvat era begins
events.summary: Vikrama era (57 BCE) — associated with victory over the Sakas.
events.detail:
One of India's major calendar eras alongside the Saka era.

**Exam hooks:** Vikrama Samvat = 57 BCE; Saka era = 78 CE (Government of India's national calendar).

events.title: Araku Valley & Borra Caves (Eastern Ghats)
events.summary: Araku hill-station & the million-year-old Borra limestone caves (Alluri dist.).
events.detail:
Eastern Ghats tourism & tribal (Adivasi) belt.

**Exam hooks:** Borra Caves — karst limestone caves; Araku coffee (GI).

events.title: AP geography: coast, ghats & three regions
events.summary: AP = Coastal Andhra + Rayalaseema; ~1000 km coastline (2nd longest).
events.detail:
Bordered by the Bay of Bengal, Eastern Ghats & the Deccan plateau.

**Exam hooks:** AP coastline ~974 km (2nd after Gujarat); Kadapa/Nallamala hills.

events.title: Kolleru & Pulicat — AP's great lakes
events.summary: Kolleru (freshwater) & Pulicat (brackish lagoon) — key wetlands & bird habitats.
events.detail:
Kolleru bird sanctuary; Pulicat near Sriharikota.

**Exam hooks:** Pulicat = India's 2nd-largest brackish-water lagoon; Kolleru Ramsar debate.

events.title: Krishna & Godavari — AP's lifelines
events.summary: The Godavari (largest peninsular river) & Krishna define AP's deltas.
events.detail:
Both drain the Eastern Ghats to the Bay of Bengal.

**Exam hooks:** Godavari = "Dakshina Ganga"; deltas = the "rice bowl" (Konaseema).

events.title: Kanishka I; Saka era begins under the Kushanas
events.summary: Kushana zenith; the Saka era (78 CE) and the Fourth Buddhist Council.
events.detail:
Kanishka patronised Mahayana Buddhism, Gandhara & Mathura art, Charaka & Ashvaghosha.

**Exam hooks:** capital Purushapura (Peshawar); Fourth Council in Kashmir formalised Mahayana.

events.title: Karikala Chola; Sangam kingdoms flourish
events.summary: Karikala founds Puhar (Kaveripattinam) and builds the Kallanai (Grand Anicut).
events.detail:
Won the battle of Venni; famed for irrigation works on the Kaveri.

**Exam hooks:** Kallanai on the Kaveri is one of the oldest working dams.

events.title: Ashvaghosha writes Buddhacharita
events.summary: Kushana-age Sanskrit poet; earliest full biography of the Buddha.
events.detail:
Court poet of Kanishka.

**Exam hooks:** Buddhacharita & Saundarananda; Mahayana texts flourish.

events.title: Gautamiputra Satakarni — Satavahana peak
events.summary: Greatest Satavahana; defeated the Saka Nahapana (Nasik prashasti).
events.detail:
Titled "destroyer of Sakas, Yavanas, Pahlavas"; his mother Gautami Balashri's Nasik inscription.

**Exam hooks:** revived the varna order; restruck Nahapana's coins.

events.title: Amaravati Stupa (Mahachaitya) flourishes
events.summary: The great Buddhist stupa at Amaravati on the Krishna — a distinctive Andhra art school.
events.detail:
White-marble carvings define the "Amaravati school"; patronised under Satavahanas/Ikshvakus.

**Exam hooks:** Amaravati, Nagarjunakonda & Ghantasala are key Andhra Buddhist sites.

events.title: Ikshvakus rule from Vijayapuri (Nagarjunakonda)
events.summary: Successors of the Satavahanas in the Krishna-Guntur region; great Buddhist patrons.
events.detail:
Nagarjunakonda (Vijayapuri) became a major Buddhist university & monastic centre.

**Exam hooks:** Ikshvakus follow the Satavahanas in coastal Andhra; queens endowed viharas.

events.title: Close of the Sangam Age; Kalabhra interregnum
events.summary: Sangam era ends; the "dark age" of Kalabhra rule follows.
events.detail:
A break before the Pallava-Pandya revival of the 6th century.

**Exam hooks:** Silappadikaram & Manimekalai = the twin Tamil epics.

events.title: Chandragupta I founds the Gupta Empire
events.summary: Gupta era begins (320 CE); title Maharajadhiraja; Lichchhavi alliance.
events.detail:
Marked the start of the "Classical/Golden Age" of ancient India.

**Exam hooks:** Gupta era 320 CE; capital Pataliputra; gold coins (dinaras).

events.title: Samudragupta; Allahabad Prashasti
events.summary: The "Napoleon of India"; conquests recorded by Harisena at Prayag.
events.detail:
The Allahabad Pillar inscription details his digvijaya, incl. southern kings.

**Exam hooks:** Harisena = court poet; performed the Ashvamedha; skilled Veena player on coins.

events.title: Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya)
events.summary: Gupta cultural zenith; defeats the Western Kshatrapas; navaratnas at court.
events.detail:
Kalidasa and the Mehrauli Iron Pillar belong here; Fa-Hien visited during his reign.

**Exam hooks:** Nine Gems (navaratnas) incl. Kalidasa; matrimonial alliance with Vakatakas.

events.title: Fa-Hien travels through Gupta India
events.summary: Chinese pilgrim Fa-Hien records Gupta-age society and Buddhism.
events.detail:
His account praises the prosperity and mild administration.

**Exam hooks:** three Chinese pilgrims — Fa-Hien (Gupta), Hiuen Tsang (Harsha), I-tsing.

events.title: Vishnukundins rule coastal Andhra
events.summary: Post-Ikshvaku dynasty controlling the Krishna-Godavari region.
events.detail:
Bridged the gap before the Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi.

**Exam hooks:** Vishnukundins — key early-medieval Andhra dynasty.

events.title: Nalanda Mahavihara flourishes
events.summary: Great Buddhist university patronised by the Guptas & Harsha.
events.detail:
Attracted scholars from across Asia (Hiuen Tsang, I-tsing).

**Exam hooks:** Nalanda (Bihar) UNESCO site; destroyed by Bakhtiyar Khilji (c.1193).

events.title: Skandagupta repels Hunas; Gupta decline
events.summary: Skandagupta checks the Huna invasions but the empire weakens.
events.detail:
Repeated Huna pressure and feudatory assertion led to fragmentation by c.550 CE.

**Exam hooks:** Junagadh inscription — Skandagupta repaired the Sudarshana lake.

events.title: Pulakeshin I founds the Chalukyas of Badami
events.summary: Badami (Vatapi) Chalukyas rise in the Deccan.
events.detail:
Rock-cut cave temples at Badami & Aihole ("cradle of temple architecture").

**Exam hooks:** Aihole inscription of Pulakeshin II by Ravikirti.

events.title: Aihole–Badami temple architecture
events.summary: Chalukyan "cradle of temple architecture"; Vesara style emerges.
events.detail:
Blending of Nagara & Dravida into the Vesara style.

**Exam hooks:** Nagara (north), Dravida (south), Vesara (Deccan) styles.

events.title: Harshavardhana ascends; capital at Kanauj
events.summary: Last great ancient north-Indian emperor; patron of Nalanda and letters.
events.detail:
Banabhatta wrote the Harshacharita; Harsha wrote Nagananda, Ratnavali, Priyadarshika.

**Exam hooks:** Kanauj becomes the political centre; Prayag & Kanauj assemblies.

events.title: Eastern Chalukyas of Vengi in Andhra
events.summary: A branch of the Badami Chalukyas rules coastal Andhra (Vengi) for centuries.
events.detail:
Fostered Telugu language & literature; Nannaya (11th c.) began the Telugu Mahabharata under them.

**Exam hooks:** Vengi = Krishna-Godavari doab; ally of the imperial Cholas by marriage.

events.title: Hiuen Tsang at Harsha's court
events.summary: Chinese pilgrim Hiuen Tsang (Xuanzang) studies at Nalanda and records India.
events.detail:
His Si-yu-ki is a prime source for 7th-century India.

**Exam hooks:** called the "Prince of Pilgrims"; studied under Silabhadra at Nalanda.

events.title: Pulakeshin II checks Harsha on the Narmada
events.summary: Chalukya Pulakeshin II halts Harsha's southward march (Aihole inscription).
events.detail:
The Narmada became the boundary between Harsha's north and the Chalukya Deccan.

**Exam hooks:** Pulakeshin II received the Persian embassy (Ajanta painting).

events.title: Pallava Narasimhavarman I sacks Vatapi
events.summary: Pallava avenges his father, defeats and kills Pulakeshin II, sacks Badami.
events.detail:
Narasimhavarman I "Vatapikonda"; began the Mamallapuram monuments.

**Exam hooks:** Pallava-Chalukya rivalry; rock-cut rathas at Mahabalipuram (UNESCO).

events.title: Death of Harsha; his empire disintegrates
events.summary: End of the classical age; north India splinters into regional kingdoms.
events.detail:
Opened the "early medieval" era of Rajput and regional powers.

**Exam hooks:** Harsha left no heir; the tripartite struggle for Kanauj follows.

events.title: Rashtrakutas dominate the Deccan
events.summary: Dantidurga founds the Rashtrakutas; Kailasa temple at Ellora under Krishna I.
events.detail:
Great patrons of art; Ellora Kailasanatha is a monolithic marvel.

**Exam hooks:** Amoghavarsha wrote Kavirajamarga (Kannada); Arab traveller Al-Masudi praised them.

events.title: Tripartite struggle for Kanauj
events.summary: Palas, Pratiharas and Rashtrakutas fight over Kanauj for two centuries.
events.detail:
Kanauj was the symbolic key to north-Indian paramountcy.

**Exam hooks:** Palas (Bengal, Dharmapala), Gurjara-Pratiharas (Bhoja), Rashtrakutas (Deccan) = the three contenders.

events.title: Imperial Cholas rise; Rajaraja I
events.summary: Rajaraja I and Rajendra I build a maritime empire; Brihadishvara temple.
events.detail:
Rajendra I reached the Ganga (Gangaikonda) and raided Srivijaya (SE Asia).

**Exam hooks:** Chola local self-government (Uttaramerur inscriptions); Dravidian temple gopurams.

events.title: Tirumala–Tirupati temple tradition
events.summary: Venkateswara temple at Tirumala — among the world's most-visited shrines.
events.detail:
Patronised by Pallavas, Cholas, Vijayanagara (Krishnadevaraya).

**Exam hooks:** Tirumala Tirupati (Chittoor); TTD administers it.

events.title: Mahmud of Ghazni raids Somnath
events.summary: Seventeen raids culminate in the sack of the Somnath temple.
events.detail:
Al-Biruni came with Ghazni and wrote the Kitab-ul-Hind (Tahqiq-i-Hind).

**Exam hooks:** Ghazni = plunder (not empire); Al-Biruni is a key source on 11th-c. India.

events.title: Nannaya begins the Telugu Mahabharatam
events.summary: "Adikavi" Nannaya starts the Andhra Mahabharatam under the Eastern Chalukyas.
events.detail:
Foundation of classical Telugu literature (the Kavitrayam: Nannaya, Tikkana, Errana).

**Exam hooks:** Nannaya = Adikavi (first poet) of Telugu.

events.title: Simhachalam & Andhra temple architecture
events.summary: Varaha-Lakshmi Narasimha temple near Visakhapatnam; Kalinga/Andhra style.
events.detail:
Patronised by Eastern Gangas & later dynasties.

**Exam hooks:** Simhachalam — famous Narasimha kshetra of coastal Andhra.

events.title: Kakatiyas assert independence at Warangal
events.summary: Prola II / Rudradeva free the Kakatiyas from Chalukya overlordship.
events.detail:
Capital Orugallu (Warangal); unified the Telugu country for the first time.

**Exam hooks:** Kakatiyas are a flagship AP dynasty; Thousand-Pillar Temple at Hanamkonda.

events.title: Second Battle of Tarain
events.summary: Muhammad Ghori defeats Prithviraj Chauhan — gateway to Turkish rule.
events.detail:
Reversed Ghori's 1191 defeat; Qutb-ud-din Aibak became his Indian deputy.

**Exam hooks:** First Tarain (1191) Rajput win; Second Tarain (1192) decisive Turkish win.

events.title: Ganapati Deva — greatest Kakatiya
events.summary: Longest-reigning Kakatiya; unified Telugu-speaking regions; Motupalli port charter.
events.detail:
His Motupalli Abhaya-Sasanam encouraged foreign maritime trade.

**Exam hooks:** Ganapati Deva's reign = Kakatiya territorial peak.

events.title: Bhakti–Sufi movements spread
events.summary: Devotional reform — Ramananda, Kabir, Nanak, Chaitanya; Chishti & Suhrawardi Sufis.
events.detail:
Emphasised personal devotion, equality and vernacular preaching.

**Exam hooks:** Nirguna (Kabir, Nanak) vs Saguna (Meera, Tulsidas, Surdas); Alvars/Nayanars in the south.

events.title: Qutb-ud-din Aibak founds the Slave dynasty
events.summary: Delhi Sultanate begins; Qutb Minar started at Delhi.
events.detail:
Aibak "Lakh-Baksh"; Iltutmish consolidated and introduced the silver tanka & copper jital.

**Exam hooks:** Five dynasties — Slave, Khilji, Tughlaq, Sayyid, Lodi (1206–1526).

events.title: Iltutmish consolidates the Sultanate
events.summary: Real consolidator of the Delhi Sultanate; the "Chihalgani" corps of forty.
events.detail:
Introduced the silver tanka and copper jital; completed the Qutb Minar.

**Exam hooks:** Iltutmish = first to get the Caliph's investiture.

events.title: Razia Sultana — first woman ruler of Delhi
events.summary: Iltutmish's daughter; the only woman to rule the Delhi Sultanate.
events.detail:
Faced Turkish noble (Chahalgani) opposition; killed in 1240.

**Exam hooks:** Razia = first & only female Sultan of Delhi.

events.title: Rani Rudrama Devi rules the Kakatiyas
events.summary: One of few women rulers of medieval India; Marco Polo praised her governance.
events.detail:
Ruled as a "male" sovereign (Rudradeva Maharaja); defended against Yadavas.

**Exam hooks:** Marco Polo visited the Kakatiya realm during/after her reign.

events.title: Amir Khusrau — "Parrot of India"
events.summary: Sufi poet-musician at the Delhi court; credited in the qawwali/sitar tradition.
events.detail:
Wrote in Persian & Hindavi.

**Exam hooks:** Amir Khusrau, disciple of Nizamuddin Auliya (Chishti).

events.title: Alauddin Khilji; market & revenue reforms
events.summary: Price-control & standing army; repelled the Mongols; Deccan expeditions.
events.detail:
Malik Kafur's southern raids reached the Pandya country.

**Exam hooks:** market reforms, dagh (branding) & chehra; Amir Khusrau at court.

events.title: Fall of the Kakatiyas; Prataparudra captured
events.summary: Ulugh Khan (Tughlaq) takes Warangal; end of Kakatiya sovereignty.
events.detail:
Prataparudra II captured; the Koh-i-Noor is associated with Kakatiya Golconda mines.

**Exam hooks:** Kakatiya fall → Musunuri Nayaks resistance & later Vijayanagara.

events.title: Muhammad-bin-Tughlaq's experiments
events.summary: Capital transfer to Daulatabad and token currency — famous failures.
events.detail:
Ibn Battuta served as his qazi and recorded the era.

**Exam hooks:** capital shift Delhi→Daulatabad; token (bronze) currency fiasco.

events.title: Reddi kingdoms rise in coastal Andhra
events.summary: Prolaya Vema Reddi founds a Telugu kingdom at Addanki/Kondavidu after Kakatiya fall.
events.detail:
Patrons of Telugu literature (Errana); repaired temples and irrigation.

**Exam hooks:** Reddi capitals Addanki, Kondavidu, Rajahmundry; contemporaries of Vijayanagara.

events.title: Musunuri Nayaks recapture Warangal
events.summary: Telugu chieftains resist the Delhi Sultanate after the Kakatiya fall.
events.detail:
Prolaya & Kapaya Nayaka led the recovery of Andhra territory.

**Exam hooks:** Musunuri Nayaks — Telugu resistance bridging Kakatiya→Vijayanagara.

events.title: Vijayanagara Empire founded
events.summary: Harihara & Bukka (Sangama dynasty) found Vijayanagara on the Tungabhadra.
events.detail:
A bulwark of southern culture; four dynasties — Sangama, Saluva, Tuluva, Aravidu.

**Exam hooks:** capital Hampi (UNESCO); Amuktamalyada by Krishnadevaraya.

events.title: Bahmani Sultanate founded in the Deccan
events.summary: Alauddin Hasan Bahman Shah founds the Deccan's first independent sultanate.
events.detail:
Capital Gulbarga, later Bidar; Mahmud Gawan was its great minister.

**Exam hooks:** Bahmani fragmented into the five Deccan Sultanates (Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar, Bidar, Berar).

events.title: Firoz Shah Tughlaq — canals & welfare
events.summary: Built canals, towns (Firozabad) and repaired monuments; imposed jizya on Brahmins.
events.detail:
Wrote Futuhat-i-Firozshahi.

**Exam hooks:** irrigation canals; Diwan-i-Khairat.

events.title: Timur sacks Delhi
events.summary: Timur's invasion devastates Delhi and hastens the Tughlaq collapse.
events.detail:
Left the Sayyid dynasty as his nominees.

**Exam hooks:** Timur's raid → Sayyids (1414) → Lodis (1451).

events.title: Lodi dynasty; Sikandar founds Agra
events.summary: First Afghan dynasty of Delhi; Sikandar Lodi shifts focus to Agra.
events.detail:
Ibrahim Lodi's conflicts with nobles invited Babur.

**Exam hooks:** last Sultanate dynasty; ends at Panipat (1526).

events.title: Vasco da Gama reaches Calicut
events.summary: First sea route from Europe to India; the Portuguese arrive.
events.detail:
Landed at Calicut; welcomed by the Zamorin. Portuguese Estado da India followed.

**Exam hooks:** Portuguese first in, last out (Goa freed 1961); Blue-Water policy (Almeida), Alfonso de Albuquerque took Goa 1510.

events.title: Krishnadevaraya — Vijayanagara zenith
events.summary: Greatest Tuluva ruler; patron of Telugu (Ashtadiggajas) and temple-building.
events.detail:
Wrote Amuktamalyada (Telugu); Portuguese envoys (Paes, Nuniz) visited.

**Exam hooks:** court poet Allasani Peddana; called "Andhra Bhoja".

events.title: Qutb Shahi dynasty founded at Golconda
events.summary: Sultan Quli Qutb-ul-Mulk founds the Golconda kingdom in Telangana/Andhra.
events.detail:
Great patrons of Telugu & Persian; Golconda famed for diamonds.

**Exam hooks:** one of the five Deccan Sultanates; Golconda fort.

events.title: First Battle of Panipat; Babur founds Mughal rule
events.summary: Babur defeats Ibrahim Lodi using artillery & tulughma tactics.
events.detail:
Babur wrote the Baburnama (Turki); founded the Mughal Empire.

**Exam hooks:** first use of field artillery in India; Panipat 1526.

events.title: Battle of Khanwa — Babur defeats Rana Sanga
events.summary: Babur defeats the Rajput confederacy under Rana Sanga of Mewar.
events.detail:
Secured Mughal power in north India after Panipat.

**Exam hooks:** Khanwa (1527) vs Rana Sanga; Ghaghra (1529) vs Afghans.

events.title: Vijayanagara after Krishnadevaraya
events.summary: Succession disputes weaken the empire before Talikota (1565).
events.detail:
Aravidu dynasty rules from Penukonda/Chandragiri afterwards.

**Exam hooks:** last dynasty = Aravidu; capital shifts to Chandragiri (AP).

events.title: Lepakshi Veerabhadra temple (Vijayanagara)
events.summary: Vijayanagara-era temple famed for murals and the hanging pillar (Anantapur).
events.detail:
A high point of Vijayanagara art in Rayalaseema.

**Exam hooks:** Lepakshi mural ceilings; the "hanging pillar".

events.title: Sher Shah Suri interrupts Mughal rule
events.summary: Humayun defeated at Kannauj; Sher Shah's Sur administration and Grand Trunk Road.
events.detail:
Introduced the silver rupiya and land-revenue (zabti) reforms later used by Akbar.

**Exam hooks:** Sher Shah built the GT Road, sarais, and the rupee.

events.title: Second Battle of Panipat; Akbar's reign secured
events.summary: Bairam Khan defeats Hemu; Akbar's long reign begins.
events.detail:
Akbar: Din-i-Ilahi, mansabdari, abolition of jizya, Todar Mal's revenue (dahsala).

**Exam hooks:** Second Panipat (1556) vs Hemu; capital Fatehpur Sikri.

events.title: Battle of Talikota (Rakshasi-Tangadi)
events.summary: Deccan Sultanate confederacy crushes Vijayanagara; Hampi is sacked.
events.detail:
Aliya Rama Raya defeated; the empire never recovered its old power.

**Exam hooks:** confederacy of Bijapur, Ahmadnagar, Golconda, Bidar defeated Vijayanagara.

events.title: Akbar proclaims Din-i-Ilahi & Sulh-i-Kul
events.summary: Syncretic faith and policy of universal tolerance.
events.detail:
Ibadat Khana debates at Fatehpur Sikri; abolished jizya (1564).

**Exam hooks:** Sulh-i-Kul; Mansabdari; Todar Mal Bandobast.

events.title: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah founds Hyderabad
events.summary: New city of Hyderabad built; the Charminar is its centrepiece.
events.detail:
Muhammad Quli was also a noted Urdu/Telugu poet.

**Exam hooks:** Charminar (1591) is the enduring symbol of the Qutb Shahi city.

events.title: Kondapalli toys & Andhra crafts (GI)
events.summary: Kondapalli wooden toys, Kalamkari & Etikoppaka among AP's GI crafts.
events.detail:
Handicraft heritage of coastal Andhra.

**Exam hooks:** GI tags — Kondapalli toys, Machilipatnam Kalamkari, Etikoppaka.

events.title: Kuchipudi — classical dance of Andhra
events.summary: Kuchipudi (Krishna dist.) systematised by Siddhendra Yogi.
events.detail:
One of India's eight classical dance forms.

**Exam hooks:** Kuchipudi from Kuchipudi village, Krishna district.

events.title: English East India Company chartered
events.summary: Queen Elizabeth I's charter creates the English East India Company.
events.detail:
Trading factories at Surat (1613), Madras (1639), Bombay (1668), Calcutta (1690).

**Exam hooks:** Dutch (1602 VOC), French (1664), Danish also came; EIC eventually dominant.

events.title: Jahangir's reign; English embassy
events.summary: Nur Jahan's influence; Sir Thomas Roe and Captain Hawkins at court.
events.detail:
Peak of Mughal painting; chain of justice (zanjir-i-adl).

**Exam hooks:** Thomas Roe (1615) got trading rights for the English East India Company.

events.title: European factories at Masulipatnam (Andhra coast)
events.summary: English and Dutch establish early factories on the Andhra coast.
events.detail:
Masulipatnam (Machilipatnam) was a major textile export port of the Coromandel.

**Exam hooks:** Coromandel/Andhra ports fed the early Company textile trade.

events.title: Shah Jahan; the Taj Mahal
events.summary: Zenith of Mughal architecture — Taj Mahal, Red Fort, Jama Masjid.
events.detail:
The "Golden Age" of Mughal building; Peacock Throne.

**Exam hooks:** Taj Mahal for Mumtaz Mahal; capital moved to Shahjahanabad (Delhi).

events.title: Aurangzeb; Mughal empire at its largest
events.summary: Widest extent but over-extension in the Deccan sows decline.
events.detail:
Re-imposed jizya; long Deccan wars against Marathas & Sultanates.

**Exam hooks:** annexed Golconda (1687) & Bijapur (1686); death 1707 → rapid decline.

events.title: Shivaji crowned; Maratha state rises
events.summary: Shivaji's coronation at Raigad establishes Maratha swarajya.
events.detail:
Ashtapradhan council; guerrilla warfare against the Mughals.

**Exam hooks:** Marathas → Peshwas → confederacy; check by Third Panipat (1761).

events.title: Aurangzeb annexes Golconda
events.summary: The last Qutb Shahi, Abul Hasan Tana Shah, is defeated; Golconda falls to the Mughals.
events.detail:
Ended independent Qutb Shahi rule; the Deccan drained Mughal strength.

**Exam hooks:** Golconda annexation (1687) precedes the rise of the Asaf Jahi Nizams.

events.title: Asaf Jahi Nizams found Hyderabad State
events.summary: Nizam-ul-Mulk asserts independence in the Deccan; Hyderabad State endures to 1948.
events.detail:
The Northern Circars later pass to the British; Rayalaseema/Telangana under the Nizam.

**Exam hooks:** Asaf Jahi (Nizams) rule Hyderabad 1724–1948; Salar Jung reforms.

events.title: Carnatic Wars (Anglo-French rivalry)
events.summary: Three wars decide Anglo-French supremacy in the south; English prevail.
events.detail:
Dupleix (French) vs Robert Clive; Wandiwash (1760) decisive.

**Exam hooks:** Treaty of Paris (1763) ended French ambitions.

events.title: Battle of Plassey
events.summary: Clive defeats Siraj-ud-Daulah via Mir Jafar's treachery — Company power in Bengal.
events.detail:
Marks the political beginning of British rule in India.

**Exam hooks:** Plassey (1757) political; Buxar (1764) legal-military consolidation.

events.title: Industrial Revolution
events.summary: Mechanised production in Britain reshapes the global economy.
events.detail:
Turned India into a raw-material supplier & market (deindustrialisation).

**Exam hooks:** drove colonial economic policy in India.

events.title: Third Battle of Panipat
events.summary: Ahmad Shah Abdali defeats the Marathas — checks Maratha expansion north.
events.detail:
Huge Maratha losses; created space for the British.

**Exam hooks:** Abdali (Durrani) vs Marathas (Sadashiv Rao Bhau).

events.title: Battle of Buxar; Diwani of Bengal
events.summary: Company defeats the Mughal-Awadh-Bengal alliance; gains Diwani (1765).
events.detail:
Treaty of Allahabad (1765) granted revenue rights over Bengal, Bihar, Odisha.

**Exam hooks:** Buxar established British legitimacy; dual government in Bengal.

events.title: British acquire the Northern Circars
events.summary: The coastal Andhra Circars pass to the English East India Company.
events.detail:
Followed the Carnatic Wars; Rayalaseema ("Ceded Districts") came in 1800 from the Nizam.

**Exam hooks:** Northern Circars (1766) & Ceded Districts/Rayalaseema (1800) = British Andhra.

events.title: Regulating Act, 1773
events.summary: First British parliamentary control over the Company; Governor-General of Bengal.
events.detail:
Warren Hastings became first GG of Bengal; Supreme Court at Calcutta (1774).

**Exam hooks:** starting point of Indian constitutional development.

events.title: American Declaration of Independence
events.summary: Thirteen colonies declare independence from Britain.
events.detail:
Enlightenment ideas of liberty & popular sovereignty; influenced later constitutions.

**Exam hooks:** inspired fundamental-rights & "we the people" ideas.

events.title: French Revolution
events.summary: Liberty, Equality, Fraternity; fall of the Bastille begins modern republicanism.
events.detail:
The Preamble ideals of the Indian Constitution echo its slogan.

**Exam hooks:** Liberty-Equality-Fraternity → Indian Preamble.

events.title: Permanent Settlement of Bengal
events.summary: Cornwallis fixes land revenue with zamindars in perpetuity.
events.detail:
Contrast with Ryotwari (Munro, south) and Mahalwari (north).

**Exam hooks:** three revenue systems — Permanent/Zamindari, Ryotwari, Mahalwari.

events.title: Wellesley's Subsidiary Alliance system
events.summary: Rulers accept British troops & Resident in return for "protection".
events.detail:
Hyderabad Nizam first to sign (1798).

**Exam hooks:** Subsidiary Alliance (Wellesley); Doctrine of Lapse (Dalhousie).

events.title: Anglo-Mysore Wars; fall of Tipu Sultan
events.summary: Tipu Sultan dies at Srirangapatna; Mysore subordinated.
events.detail:
Four wars (1767–99); Tipu the "Tiger of Mysore".

**Exam hooks:** Tipu introduced rockets; died 1799.

events.title: Raja Ram Mohan Roy founds Brahmo Samaj
events.summary: Socio-religious reform; campaign against sati (abolished 1829).
events.detail:
"Father of the Indian Renaissance"; monotheism and rational reform.

**Exam hooks:** Sati abolished 1829 (Bentinck); Arya Samaj (Dayananda, 1875); Ramakrishna Mission (Vivekananda, 1897).

events.title: Bentinck — social reform (abolition of Sati)
events.summary: Abolishes Sati (1829) and suppresses Thuggee; English as the medium of education.
events.detail:
Macaulay's Minute (1835) followed.

**Exam hooks:** Bentinck + Ram Mohan Roy → Sati abolition.

events.title: Dalhousie's Doctrine of Lapse
events.summary: Annexation of states without a natural heir; a cause of 1857.
events.detail:
Satara, Jhansi, Nagpur, Awadh annexed.

**Exam hooks:** Dalhousie also brought railways (1853) & telegraph.

events.title: Dowleswaram (Cotton) Barrage on the Godavari
events.summary: Sir Arthur Cotton's anicut transforms Godavari-delta agriculture.
events.detail:
Made the delta the "rice bowl" of Andhra.

**Exam hooks:** Arthur Cotton — Dowleswaram Barrage (Rajahmundry).

events.title: Salar Jung reforms in Hyderabad State
events.summary: Salar Jung I modernises the Nizam's administration.
events.detail:
Legacy includes the Salar Jung Museum collection.

**Exam hooks:** Salar Jung — Diwan of Hyderabad; famous museum.

events.title: First railway line: Bombay–Thane
events.summary: India's first passenger train runs 34 km Bombay to Thane.
events.detail:
Under Governor-General Dalhousie.

**Exam hooks:** railways, telegraph & postage all introduced by Dalhousie.

events.title: Revolt of 1857
events.summary: First War of Independence begins at Meerut; ends Company rule.
events.detail:
Centres: Delhi (Bahadur Shah II), Kanpur (Nana Sahib), Jhansi (Lakshmibai), Lucknow (Begum Hazrat Mahal).

**Exam hooks:** immediate cause = greased cartridges (Mangal Pandey); led to the Government of India Act 1858.

events.title: Government of India Act 1858; Crown rule
events.summary: Company rule ends; the British Crown assumes direct control of India.
events.detail:
Secretary of State for India + Viceroy (Canning first Viceroy).

**Exam hooks:** 1858 Act = Crown takeover; Queen's Proclamation.

events.title: Dayananda founds the Arya Samaj
events.summary: "Back to the Vedas"; reform of caste, idolatry and untouchability.
events.detail:
Shuddhi movement; Satyarth Prakash.

**Exam hooks:** Arya Samaj (1875); Ramakrishna Mission (1897, Vivekananda).

events.title: Kandukuri Veeresalingam — Telugu social reform
events.summary: Pioneer of widow remarriage & women's education in the Telugu country.
events.detail:
"Father of the Telugu Renaissance"; founded reform associations.

**Exam hooks:** Kandukuri Veeresalingam — first Telugu widow remarriage (1881).

events.title: Lord Ripon — local self-government & Ilbert Bill
events.summary: "Father of local self-government in India"; repealed the Vernacular Press Act.
events.detail:
Ilbert Bill controversy (1883).

**Exam hooks:** Ripon 1882 Resolution on local self-government.

events.title: Indian National Congress founded
events.summary: A.O. Hume convenes the first INC session at Bombay (W.C. Bonnerjee, president).
events.detail:
Moderate phase (1885–1905) — prayer, petition, protest.

**Exam hooks:** first session Bombay 1885; Hume the "father"; Bonnerjee first president.

events.title: Moderate phase of the Congress
events.summary: Dadabhai Naoroji's "drain theory"; constitutional agitation.
events.detail:
Gokhale, Ranade, Pherozeshah Mehta led early demands.

**Exam hooks:** Naoroji "Grand Old Man"; drain of wealth (Poverty & Un-British Rule).

events.title: Gurajada Apparao writes Kanyasulkam
events.summary: Landmark Telugu social play attacking bride-price; modern Telugu literature.
events.detail:
Also wrote "Desamunu Preminchumanna" (patriotic song).

**Exam hooks:** Gurajada — Kanyasulkam; father of modern Telugu literature.

events.title: Andhra handloom & GI heritage
events.summary: Venkatagiri, Mangalagiri, Uppada Jamdani & Dharmavaram sarees.
events.detail:
A rich AP handloom tradition with several GI tags.

**Exam hooks:** AP GI textiles — Uppada Jamdani, Mangalagiri, Venkatagiri.

events.title: Partition of Bengal; Swadeshi movement
events.summary: Curzon's partition triggers Swadeshi & Boycott; rise of the Extremists.
events.detail:
Boycott of foreign goods, national education, swadeshi enterprise.

**Exam hooks:** Lal-Bal-Pal; Bengal partition annulled 1911, capital moved to Delhi.

events.title: Curzon — administrative reforms & partition
events.summary: Universities Act, ASI reorganisation and the contested Bengal partition.
events.detail:
His partition of Bengal ignited Swadeshi.

**Exam hooks:** Curzon founded the modern ASI; partition 1905.

events.title: Surat Split of the Congress
events.summary: Congress splits into Moderates & Extremists at Surat.
events.detail:
Reunited at the Lucknow session (1916).

**Exam hooks:** Surat Split (1907) over methods & presidency.

events.title: Andhra movement for a separate province
events.summary: First Andhra Mahasabha (1913) demands a separate Telugu-speaking province from Madras.
events.detail:
Linguistic-identity politics led by Telugu leaders in the Madras Presidency.

**Exam hooks:** early demand that culminated in Andhra State (1953).

events.title: World War I
events.summary: Global war; India contributed troops and money, fuelling nationalist demands.
events.detail:
Post-war disillusion (Rowlatt, Jallianwala) intensified the freedom struggle.

**Exam hooks:** WWI (1914–18); Treaty of Versailles (1919); League of Nations.

events.title: Lucknow Pact; Home Rule Leagues
events.summary: Congress–Muslim League unity; Tilak & Besant launch Home Rule.
events.detail:
Reunion of Moderates & Extremists; joint demand for self-government.

**Exam hooks:** Lucknow Pact (1916) = Congress-League cooperation.

events.title: Champaran Satyagraha — Gandhi's first in India
events.summary: Indigo cultivators' struggle in Bihar; first Indian satyagraha.
events.detail:
Followed by Kheda (1918) & Ahmedabad Mill strike.

**Exam hooks:** Champaran (1917) = first civil-disobedience experiment in India.

events.title: Russian Revolution
events.summary: Bolshevik Revolution establishes the world's first socialist state.
events.detail:
Influenced socialist thought in the Indian national movement.

**Exam hooks:** 1917 October Revolution; Lenin; inspired "Socialist" in the Preamble (42nd).

events.title: Rowlatt Act & Jallianwala Bagh massacre
events.summary: Dyer's firing at Amritsar; a turning point that radicalised the movement.
events.detail:
Tagore renounced knighthood; Hunter Commission enquiry.

**Exam hooks:** Rowlatt (1919) "no dalil, no vakil, no appeal"; also GoI Act 1919 (dyarchy).

events.title: Non-Cooperation & Khilafat Movement
events.summary: Gandhi's first mass satyagraha; withdrawn after Chauri Chaura (1922).
events.detail:
Boycott of titles, schools, courts, foreign cloth.

**Exam hooks:** NCM (1920) launched with Khilafat; called off after Chauri Chaura violence.

events.title: Pingali Venkayya designs the national flag
events.summary: Machilipatnam-born freedom fighter designs the tricolour.
events.detail:
The Ashoka-Chakra tricolour derives from his design.

**Exam hooks:** Pingali Venkayya (AP) = designer of the Indian flag.

events.title: Harappa discovered (ASI, 1921)
events.summary: Daya Ram Sahni excavates Harappa; Mohenjo-daro (Banerji) follows in 1922.
events.detail:
Brought the Indus Civilisation to modern knowledge.

**Exam hooks:** Harappa 1921 (Sahni); Mohenjo-daro 1922 (R.D. Banerji); John Marshall announced it.

events.title: Rampa Rebellion — Alluri Sitarama Raju
events.summary: Tribal armed revolt in the Andhra Agency led by Alluri Sitarama Raju ("Manyam Veerudu").
events.detail:
Fought British forest laws in the Godavari/Visakhapatnam hills; captured & killed 1924.

**Exam hooks:** Alluri Sitarama Raju is the pre-eminent Andhra freedom icon; Bhogapuram airport named after him.

events.title: Tanguturi Prakasam "Andhra Kesari"
events.summary: Bared his chest to police guns in Madras; later first CM of Andhra State.
events.detail:
Symbol of Andhra nationalism; Prakasam district named after him.

**Exam hooks:** Tanguturi Prakasam = "Andhra Kesari"; first CM of Andhra State (1953).

events.title: Bardoli Satyagraha
events.summary: Patel leads a no-tax peasant movement; earns the title "Sardar".
events.detail:
A model of disciplined civil resistance.

**Exam hooks:** Bardoli (1928); Vallabhbhai Patel = "Sardar".

events.title: Simon Commission boycott
events.summary: "Simon Go Back"; Lala Lajpat Rai fatally injured in the Lahore protest.
events.detail:
An all-white commission with no Indian member sparked nationwide protest.

**Exam hooks:** led to the Nehru Report (1928) and Jinnah's Fourteen Points (1929).

events.title: Purna Swaraj declaration (Lahore Congress)
events.summary: Congress adopts complete independence; 26 Jan 1930 first Independence Day.
events.detail:
Nehru hoisted the tricolour on the Ravi; set the stage for Civil Disobedience.

**Exam hooks:** Purna Swaraj (1929) → 26 Jan chosen later as Republic Day (1950).

events.title: Dandi March & Civil Disobedience
events.summary: Gandhi's salt satyagraha from Sabarmati to Dandi launches Civil Disobedience.
events.detail:
Breaking the salt law became a mass symbol of defiance.

**Exam hooks:** Dandi (1930) → Gandhi-Irwin Pact (1931) → Second Round Table Conference.

events.title: Gandhi–Irwin Pact
events.summary: Civil Disobedience suspended; Gandhi attends the Second Round Table Conference.
events.detail:
Political prisoners released; salt-making allowed on the coast.

**Exam hooks:** followed by the Karachi Session (Fundamental Rights resolution).

events.title: Poona Pact (Gandhi–Ambedkar)
events.summary: Replaces separate electorates for Depressed Classes with reserved seats.
events.detail:
Followed the Communal Award (1932) & Gandhi's fast.

**Exam hooks:** Poona Pact → reservation of seats within joint electorates.

events.title: Visakhapatnam Port — a major eastern gateway
events.summary: One of India's major ports; deep natural harbour on the east coast.
events.detail:
Anchors AP's industrial & shipbuilding base.

**Exam hooks:** Vizag = major port + Eastern Naval Command HQ.

events.title: Government of India Act, 1935
events.summary: Provincial autonomy & an all-India federation scheme — a template for the Constitution.
events.detail:
Much of its administrative machinery was carried into the 1950 Constitution.

**Exam hooks:** abolished dyarchy at provinces, introduced it at the Centre; Federal Court (1937).

events.title: Reserve Bank of India established
events.summary: India's central bank set up on the Hilton-Young Commission recommendation.
events.detail:
Nationalised in 1949.

**Exam hooks:** RBI (1935); functions — monetary authority, banker's bank, currency issue.

events.title: Sri Bagh Pact
events.summary: Coastal-Andhra & Rayalaseema leaders agree to share benefits within a future Andhra state.
events.detail:
Sought to reassure Rayalaseema on capital/high-court and irrigation.

**Exam hooks:** Sri Bagh Pact (1937) — regional-balance agreement; echoes in Amaravati/decentralisation debates.

events.title: World War II
events.summary: Global conflict; India dragged in without consent → Quit India (1942).
events.detail:
Ended with the atomic bombings; reshaped the post-colonial order.

**Exam hooks:** WWII (1939–45); Cripps Mission & Quit India context.

events.title: Quit India Movement
events.summary: "Do or Die"; the final mass movement demanding British withdrawal.
events.detail:
Leaders arrested; underground activity (Aruna Asaf Ali, JP Narayan).

**Exam hooks:** Quit India (1942) after the failed Cripps Mission.

events.title: Subhas Bose leads the INA
events.summary: Netaji reorganises the Azad Hind Fauj; "Give me blood, I'll give you freedom".
events.detail:
Provisional Government of Free India (Azad Hind); INA trials (1945) roused opinion.

**Exam hooks:** Bose founded Forward Bloc (1939); INA allied with Japan.

events.title: Bretton Woods — IMF & World Bank
events.summary: Post-war monetary order; creates the IMF and the World Bank.
events.detail:
Foundation of the global financial architecture.

**Exam hooks:** IMF (stability) & World Bank (development); India a founder member.

events.title: United Nations founded
events.summary: UN established after WWII; India a founding member.
events.detail:
Security Council, ICJ, specialised agencies (UNESCO, WHO).

**Exam hooks:** UN (1945) HQ New York; India seeks a permanent UNSC seat.

events.title: Constituent Assembly convened
events.summary: First sitting under the Cabinet Mission Plan; Rajendra Prasad elected president.
events.detail:
Drafting Committee chaired by B.R. Ambedkar; Objectives Resolution by Nehru (1946).

**Exam hooks:** CA took 2 yrs 11 mo 18 days; B.N. Rau constitutional adviser.

events.title: Cabinet Mission Plan
events.summary: Proposed a loose federation & the Constituent Assembly framework.
events.detail:
Rejected partition but grouped provinces.

**Exam hooks:** Cabinet Mission (1946) → Constituent Assembly elections.

events.title: Royal Indian Navy Mutiny
events.summary: Naval ratings revolt in Bombay — a final push before transfer of power.
events.detail:
Signalled the unreliability of the armed forces to the British.

**Exam hooks:** RIN Mutiny (1946) hastened British withdrawal.

events.title: Cold War & bipolar world order
events.summary: US–USSR rivalry; India's response was non-alignment.
events.detail:
Shaped India's foreign policy for decades.

**Exam hooks:** Cold War (1947–91); NAM as India's middle path.

events.title: Indian Independence & Partition
events.summary: India becomes independent; Partition creates India and Pakistan.
events.detail:
Mountbatten Plan (3 June 1947); Indian Independence Act 1947.

**Exam hooks:** Radcliffe Line; Nehru first PM; Mountbatten last Viceroy/first GG.

events.title: Integration of Princely States (Sardar Patel)
events.summary: Patel & V.P. Menon integrate 560+ princely states via the Instrument of Accession.
events.detail:
Junagadh, Hyderabad and Kashmir were the difficult cases.

**Exam hooks:** Patel = "Iron Man / Bismarck of India"; Statue of Unity.

events.title: Objectives Resolution → Preamble
events.summary: Nehru's Objectives Resolution (1946) becomes the basis of the Preamble.
events.detail:
Sovereign, socialist, secular, democratic republic; justice, liberty, equality, fraternity.

**Exam hooks:** Preamble = "identity card of the Constitution" (N.A. Palkhivala).

events.title: Operation Polo — Hyderabad annexed
events.summary: Police action ends the Nizam's rule; Hyderabad State joins the Union.
events.detail:
Followed the Telangana peasant armed struggle against the Nizam & razakars.

**Exam hooks:** Operation Polo (Sept 1948) integrated Hyderabad; Telangana Rebellion (1946–51).

events.title: Constitution adopted
events.summary: Constitution adopted by the Constituent Assembly (National Constitution Day).
events.detail:
Signed and adopted 26 Nov 1949; celebrated as Samvidhan Divas.

**Exam hooks:** adopted 26 Nov 1949; came into force 26 Jan 1950.

events.title: Comptroller & Auditor-General (CAG) office
events.summary: Constitutional auditor of the Union & States (Art. 148).
events.detail:
"Guardian of the public purse" — Ambedkar.

**Exam hooks:** CAG Art. 148–151; reports tabled before PAC.

events.title: Directive Principles (Part IV)
events.summary: Non-justiciable goals for a welfare state (Arts. 36–51); Irish-inspired.
events.detail:
Gandhian, socialist & liberal-intellectual principles.

**Exam hooks:** DPSP from Ireland; "instrument of instructions".

events.title: Election Commission of India established
events.summary: Constitutional body (Art. 324) to conduct elections; National Voters' Day.
events.detail:
Sukumar Sen the first CEC; multi-member since 1993.

**Exam hooks:** Art. 324; 25 Jan = National Voters' Day.

events.title: Fundamental Rights (Part III) enacted
events.summary: Six categories of justiciable rights (Arts. 12–35).
events.detail:
Right to Property removed (44th, 1978).

**Exam hooks:** FR = equality, freedom, against exploitation, religion, cultural-educational, constitutional remedies (Art.32 — "heart & soul").

events.title: Planning Commission established
events.summary: Extra-constitutional body to formulate Five-Year Plans (PM as chairman).
events.detail:
Replaced by NITI Aayog in 2015.

**Exam hooks:** Planning Commission (1950); first Deputy Chairman era; Mahalanobis model.

events.title: Constitution comes into force — Republic Day
events.summary: India becomes a sovereign democratic republic; Rajendra Prasad first President.
events.detail:
Date chosen to honour Purna Swaraj Day (1930).

**Exam hooks:** commencement 26 Jan 1950; Supreme Court established 28 Jan 1950.

events.title: Union Public Service Commission (UPSC)
events.summary: Central recruiting agency (Art. 315–323); successor to the 1926 PSC.
events.detail:
Conducts the Civil Services Examination.

**Exam hooks:** UPSC Art. 315; State PSCs (like APPSC) parallel it.

events.title: First Constitutional Amendment
events.summary: Adds the Ninth Schedule and reasonable restrictions on free speech; land reforms shielded.
events.detail:
Enacted by the Provisional Parliament under Nehru.

**Exam hooks:** 1st Amendment (1951) → Ninth Schedule; tested in Shankari Prasad.

events.title: First Finance Commission
events.summary: Art. 280 body recommending Centre–State tax devolution every 5 years.
events.detail:
K.C. Neogy chaired the first (1951).

**Exam hooks:** Finance Commission Art. 280; vertical & horizontal devolution.

events.title: First Five-Year Plan launched
events.summary: Harrod-Domar model; priority to agriculture & irrigation (Bhakra-Nangal).
events.detail:
Second Plan (Mahalanobis, 1956) stressed heavy industry.

**Exam hooks:** 1st Plan = agriculture; 2nd = industry; plan holidays 1966–69.

events.title: Potti Sriramulu's fast & martyrdom
events.summary: Dies after a 58-day fast for a separate Andhra state — the catalyst for statehood.
events.detail:
His death forced Nehru to concede a Telugu-speaking state.

**Exam hooks:** "Amarajeevi" Potti Sriramulu; martyrdom Dec 1952 → Andhra State 1953.

events.title: Andhra State formed (capital Kurnool)
events.summary: India's first linguistic state, carved from the Madras Presidency.
events.detail:
Capital Kurnool; High Court at Guntur; T. Prakasam first CM.

**Exam hooks:** Andhra State (1 Oct 1953) = first linguistic state of India.

events.title: Andhra Pradesh formed (Vishalandhra)
events.summary: Andhra State merges with Telangana (Hyderabad State) to form Andhra Pradesh.
events.detail:
Under the States Reorganisation Act; capital Hyderabad; Gentlemen's Agreement safeguards.

**Exam hooks:** AP formed 1 Nov 1956; N. Sanjeeva Reddy first CM; Gentlemen's Agreement (1956).

events.title: States Reorganisation Act, 1956
events.summary: Linguistic reorganisation of states; 7th Amendment restructures the federation.
events.detail:
Based on the Fazl Ali Commission; Andhra Pradesh formed on 1 Nov 1956.

**Exam hooks:** SRC 1953 (Fazl Ali, K.M. Panikkar, H.N. Kunzru); 14 states + 6 UTs.

events.title: Berubari Union case
events.summary: SC holds the Preamble is not part of the Constitution (later revised).
events.detail:
Cession of territory needs a constitutional amendment.

**Exam hooks:** Berubari (1960) vs Kesavananda (1973) on the Preamble.

events.title: Liberation of Goa (Operation Vijay)
events.summary: India ends 450 years of Portuguese rule in Goa, Daman & Diu.
events.detail:
Portuguese were the first to arrive and the last European power to leave.

**Exam hooks:** Goa liberated 1961; became a full state in 1987.

events.title: Non-Aligned Movement founded
events.summary: Belgrade summit; Nehru a key architect of NAM.
events.detail:
Cold-War neutrality; Panchsheel principles (1954).

**Exam hooks:** NAM (1961); founders — Nehru, Nasser, Tito, Sukarno, Nkrumah.

events.title: Green Revolution
events.summary: HYV seeds, fertilisers & irrigation make India food-grain self-sufficient.
events.detail:
M.S. Swaminathan & Norman Borlaug; wheat-led (Punjab, Haryana, UP).

**Exam hooks:** Green (food), White (milk-Operation Flood), Blue (fish) revolutions.

events.title: Nagarjunasagar Dam completed
events.summary: One of the world's largest masonry dams, on the Krishna river.
events.detail:
Nehru laid the foundation; major irrigation & hydel source.

**Exam hooks:** Nagarjunasagar on the Krishna; Nagarjunakonda relics relocated.

events.title: Golaknath case
events.summary: SC rules Parliament cannot amend Fundamental Rights (later overruled).
events.detail:
Prompted the 24th Amendment (1971) asserting amending power.

**Exam hooks:** Golaknath (1967) → Kesavananda (1973) reversed it with the Basic Structure doctrine.

events.title: Bank nationalisation
events.summary: 14 major commercial banks nationalised to widen credit reach.
events.detail:
Six more nationalised in 1980; priority-sector lending expanded.

**Exam hooks:** 1969 (14 banks) & 1980 (6 banks); RBI est. 1935, nationalised 1949.

events.title: ISRO founded
events.summary: Indian Space Research Organisation set up; Vikram Sarabhai the "father".
events.detail:
Successor to INCOSPAR (1962); HQ Bengaluru.

**Exam hooks:** Vikram Sarabhai = father of Indian space programme; DoS under the PM.

events.title: Satish Dhawan Space Centre (Sriharikota)
events.summary: ISRO's primary launch site on Sriharikota island (Nellore dist., AP).
events.detail:
All PSLV/GSLV/LVM3 launches (incl. Chandrayaan) lift off from here.

**Exam hooks:** SHAR/SDSC is in Andhra Pradesh — a key AP-space link.

events.title: Visakhapatnam Steel Plant sanctioned
events.summary: RINL's shore-based integrated steel plant — fruit of the "Visakha Ukku" movement.
events.detail:
Commissioned 1992; India's first shore-based steel plant.

**Exam hooks:** "Visakha Ukku – Andhrula Hakku" agitation.

events.title: Jai Andhra & Six-Point Formula
events.summary: Regional agitations lead to the Six-Point Formula (1973) and 32nd Amendment.
events.detail:
Addressed Mulki rules & regional imbalance; Art. 371D safeguards.

**Exam hooks:** Six-Point Formula (1973) → Article 371D (special provisions for AP).

events.title: Kesavananda Bharati — Basic Structure doctrine
events.summary: Landmark 13-judge bench: Parliament may amend but not destroy the "basic structure".
events.detail:
The most important constitutional case; limits Art. 368 amending power.

**Exam hooks:** Basic Structure includes rule of law, judicial review, federalism, secularism.

events.title: Pokhran-I nuclear test (Smiling Buddha)
events.summary: India's first nuclear test — a "peaceful nuclear explosion".
events.detail:
Conducted at Pokhran, Rajasthan under Homi Sethna/Raja Ramanna.

**Exam hooks:** Pokhran-I (1974) "Smiling Buddha"; Pokhran-II (1998) "Operation Shakti".

events.title: Aryabhata — India's first satellite
events.summary: India's first satellite launched (from the Soviet Union).
events.detail:
Named after the ancient astronomer-mathematician.

**Exam hooks:** Aryabhata (1975); first Indian-launched satellite = Rohini via SLV-3 (1980).

events.title: National Emergency (1975–77)
events.summary: Internal Emergency under Article 352; civil liberties suspended.
events.detail:
Followed the Allahabad HC verdict against Indira Gandhi; 42nd Amendment passed.

**Exam hooks:** led to the 44th Amendment (1978) safeguards; only internal Emergency in Indian history.

events.title: 42nd Amendment — the "Mini-Constitution"
events.summary: Adds Socialist, Secular, Integrity to the Preamble; Fundamental Duties; DPSP primacy.
events.detail:
Enacted during the Emergency; partly rolled back by the 44th (1978).

**Exam hooks:** 42nd added Part IVA (Fundamental Duties) & the words in the Preamble.

events.title: 44th Amendment — restores balance
events.summary: Undoes Emergency-era excesses; right to property made a legal right.
events.detail:
Art. 20 & 21 non-suspendable even during Emergency.

**Exam hooks:** 44th (1978) removed property (Art.31) from Fundamental Rights.

events.title: Maneka Gandhi v. Union of India
events.summary: Expands Article 21 — "procedure established by law" must be just, fair and reasonable.
events.detail:
Linked Articles 14, 19 and 21 (the "golden triangle").

**Exam hooks:** widened right to life & personal liberty; due-process reading.

events.title: Minerva Mills v. Union of India
events.summary: Reaffirms Basic Structure; balance between Fundamental Rights and DPSP.
events.detail:
Struck down parts of the 42nd Amendment.

**Exam hooks:** judicial review & limited amending power are basic features.

events.title: SLV-3 launches Rohini — first Indian launch
events.summary: India's first indigenous satellite launch vehicle succeeds; A.P.J. Abdul Kalam project director.
events.detail:
Put Rohini RS-1 into orbit.

**Exam hooks:** SLV-3 (1980); Kalam = "Missile Man".

events.title: Srisailam Dam on the Krishna
events.summary: Major hydro-electric project; adjoins the Nallamala forests & tiger reserve.
events.detail:
Srisailam is also a famous Jyotirlinga/Shakti-peetha temple town.

**Exam hooks:** Srisailam — Krishna hydel + Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve.

events.title: N.T. Rama Rao founds the Telugu Desam Party
events.summary: NTR founds TDP on Telugu self-respect; becomes CM in 1983.
events.detail:
Ended single-party dominance in AP politics.

**Exam hooks:** TDP (1982) on "Telugu atma-gauravam".

events.title: NABARD established
events.summary: Apex bank for agriculture & rural development.
events.detail:
Refinances rural credit; SHG-bank linkage.

**Exam hooks:** NABARD (1982); SIDBI (1990) for small industry.

events.title: 52nd Amendment — Anti-Defection Law
events.summary: Adds the Tenth Schedule to curb political defections.
events.detail:
Disqualification decided by the presiding officer.

**Exam hooks:** 52nd Amendment (1985) → Tenth Schedule; strengthened by 91st (2003).

events.title: Shah Bano case & aftermath
events.summary: SC grants maintenance under CrPC 125; sparked the debate on personal law.
events.detail:
Led to the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights) Act 1986.

**Exam hooks:** uniform civil code (Art. 44) debate.

events.title: Agni missile series (IGMDP)
events.summary: Agni ballistic missiles under the Integrated Guided Missile Development Programme.
events.detail:
Kalam led the IGMDP (Prithvi, Agni, Trishul, Akash, Nag).

**Exam hooks:** IGMDP (1983); Agni = surface-to-surface ballistic.

events.title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
events.summary: End of the Cold War division of Europe; USSR dissolves (1991).
events.detail:
Ushered in a unipolar moment & globalisation.

**Exam hooks:** 1989 wall falls; 1991 Soviet collapse.

events.title: LPG Economic Reforms of 1991
events.summary: Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation end the licence-permit raj.
events.detail:
Response to a balance-of-payments crisis; Manmohan Singh as FM.

**Exam hooks:** New Industrial Policy 1991; rupee devaluation; delicensing.

events.title: PARAM supercomputer developed (C-DAC)
events.summary: India's first indigenous supercomputer after denial of imports.
events.detail:
Developed by C-DAC under Vijay Bhatkar.

**Exam hooks:** PARAM (1991); National Supercomputing Mission today.

events.title: 73rd & 74th Amendments — local self-government
events.summary: Constitutionalise Panchayati Raj (Part IX) and Municipalities (Part IX-A).
events.detail:
Three-tier PRIs, State Election Commission, reservation for women/SC/ST.

**Exam hooks:** came into force 1993; 11th & 12th Schedules; Balwant Rai Mehta & Ashok Mehta committees.

events.title: Indra Sawhney (Mandal) case
events.summary: Upholds 27% OBC reservation; caps total reservation at 50%; "creamy layer".
events.detail:
Followed the implementation of the Mandal Commission report.

**Exam hooks:** 50% ceiling; creamy-layer exclusion for OBCs.

events.title: SEBI gets statutory status
events.summary: Securities market regulator empowered after the 1992 scam.
events.detail:
Protects investors; regulates stock exchanges.

**Exam hooks:** SEBI Act 1992; Harshad Mehta scam context.

events.title: S.R. Bommai v. Union of India
events.summary: Curbs misuse of Article 356; federalism & secularism declared basic features.
events.detail:
Floor test in the Assembly is the proper test of majority.

**Exam hooks:** Bommai (1994) checked arbitrary President's Rule.

events.title: PSLV's first successful flight
events.summary: Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle becomes ISRO's reliable workhorse.
events.detail:
Later launched Chandrayaan-1 & Mangalyaan; 104-satellite record (2017).

**Exam hooks:** PSLV workhorse; GSLV for heavier/geostationary payloads.

events.title: India joins the WTO
events.summary: WTO succeeds GATT; India a founder member.
events.detail:
Rules on trade, TRIPS, agriculture and services.

**Exam hooks:** WTO (1995) HQ Geneva; India uses the peace-clause on MSP/food security.

events.title: Vishaka Guidelines on workplace harassment
events.summary: SC lays down guidelines against sexual harassment at the workplace.
events.detail:
Basis of the POSH Act, 2013.

**Exam hooks:** Vishaka (1997) invoked international conventions (CEDAW).

events.title: Pokhran-II (Operation Shakti)
events.summary: Five nuclear tests; India declares itself a nuclear-weapon state.
events.detail:
Led to a period of sanctions; NFU (No First Use) doctrine.

**Exam hooks:** May 1998 tests; A.P.J. Abdul Kalam & R. Chidambaram associated.

events.title: BrahMos supersonic cruise missile
events.summary: India–Russia joint supersonic cruise missile enters service.
events.detail:
Named after the Brahmaputra & Moskva rivers.

**Exam hooks:** BrahMos (DRDO + NPOM); now exported (Philippines).

events.title: FRBM Act, 2003
events.summary: Fiscal Responsibility & Budget Management — fiscal-deficit discipline.
events.detail:
Targets for fiscal & revenue deficits.

**Exam hooks:** FRBM (2003); N.K. Singh Committee review.

events.title: Y.S. Rajasekhara Reddy becomes CM
events.summary: YSR's tenure known for welfare (Arogyasri, Jalayagnam irrigation).
events.detail:
Arogyasri health scheme became a model.

**Exam hooks:** YSR — Rajiv Arogyasri; Jalayagnam.

events.title: MGNREGA enacted
events.summary: Legal guarantee of 100 days' wage employment to rural households.
events.detail:
World's largest public-works programme; demand-driven.

**Exam hooks:** MGNREGA (2005) = right to work; renamed after Mahatma Gandhi in 2009.

events.title: Right to Information Act, 2005
events.summary: Empowers citizens to seek information from public authorities.
events.detail:
Information Commissions at Centre & States.

**Exam hooks:** RTI (2005) flows from Art. 19(1)(a).

events.title: Chandrayaan-1 finds water on the Moon
events.summary: India's first lunar mission; confirmed lunar water molecules.
events.detail:
Launched by PSLV-C11; carried the Moon Impact Probe.

**Exam hooks:** Chandrayaan-1 (2008) detected water; Chandrayaan-2 (2019) partial.

events.title: 97th Amendment — Co-operative societies
events.summary: Right to form co-operatives (Art. 19); adds Part IX-B.
events.detail:
Some provisions later struck down for states' domain.

**Exam hooks:** 97th (2011) → co-operative societies.

events.title: Mangalyaan (Mars Orbiter Mission)
events.summary: India reaches Mars orbit on its first attempt — a global first.
events.detail:
Most cost-effective interplanetary mission at the time.

**Exam hooks:** MOM (2013); India = first Asian & first-attempt success at Mars.

events.title: APCRDA & Amaravati capital region
events.summary: AP Capital Region Development Authority set up to build Amaravati.
events.detail:
Managed the land-pooling scheme.

**Exam hooks:** APCRDA (2014) governs the Amaravati capital region.

events.title: AP–Telangana Krishna/Godavari water sharing
events.summary: Post-bifurcation river-water disputes (Krishna & Godavari boards).
events.detail:
KRMB & GRMB manage inter-state allocation.

**Exam hooks:** Krishna & Godavari River Management Boards (2014 Act).

events.title: AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 passed
events.summary: Parliament passes the Act bifurcating Andhra Pradesh to create Telangana.
events.detail:
Provided for Hyderabad as common capital (up to 10 years) & special assistance.

**Exam hooks:** AP Reorganisation Act 2014; Section 5 on the capital; Schedule provisions.

events.title: AP Special Category Status demand
events.summary: Post-bifurcation demand for Special Category Status / special package.
events.detail:
A recurring centre-state fiscal issue for residuary AP.

**Exam hooks:** SCS debate; special assistance under the 2014 Act.

events.title: Appointed Day — Telangana & residual AP
events.summary: Telangana becomes India's 29th state; residuary Andhra Pradesh continues.
events.detail:
AP loses Hyderabad as permanent capital; begins building a new capital.

**Exam hooks:** Appointed Day 2 June 2014; Hyderabad common capital for up to 10 years.

events.title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
events.summary: Mass financial-inclusion drive; zero-balance bank accounts.
events.detail:
Backbone of Direct Benefit Transfer (JAM trinity).

**Exam hooks:** PMJDY (2014); JAM = Jan Dhan-Aadhaar-Mobile.

events.title: Swachh Bharat Mission launched
events.summary: National sanitation/ODF campaign on Gandhi Jayanti.
events.detail:
Rural & urban components; toilets & solid-waste management.

**Exam hooks:** SBM (2014); ODF declarations.

events.title: Amaravati chosen as AP's greenfield capital
events.summary: Amaravati on the Krishna designated the new capital; land-pooling model.
events.detail:
APCRDA & the land-pooling scheme aggregated farmland from farmers.

**Exam hooks:** Amaravati capital; land-pooling (not acquisition); strained state finances.

events.title: Amaravati as an ancient toponym revived
events.summary: The new capital revives the name of the ancient Buddhist Amaravati.
events.detail:
Links modern statehood to Satavahana-era heritage.

**Exam hooks:** Amaravati — ancient stupa town & modern capital both on the Krishna.

events.title: Godavari & Krishna Pushkaram traditions
events.summary: Twelve-yearly river festivals draw millions to AP's riverbanks.
events.detail:
Rajahmundry (Godavari) & Vijayawada (Krishna) are focal points.

**Exam hooks:** Pushkaram = river festival every 12 years.

events.title: NITI Aayog replaces the Planning Commission
events.summary: A think-tank for cooperative & competitive federalism.
events.detail:
No longer allocates funds; advisory & monitoring role.

**Exam hooks:** NITI = National Institution for Transforming India; Governing Council of CMs.

events.title: NJAC struck down; collegium retained
events.summary: SC voids the 99th Amendment/NJAC — judicial-appointments primacy retained.
events.detail:
Reaffirmed judicial independence as basic structure.

**Exam hooks:** collegium system continues; NJAC (2014) unconstitutional (2015).

events.title: Paris Climate Agreement
events.summary: Global pact to limit warming to well below 2°C; India ratified 2016.
events.detail:
Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs).

**Exam hooks:** India's Panchamrit & net-zero-2070 at COP26.

events.title: 101st Amendment — Goods & Services Tax
events.summary: Constitutional basis for GST; creates the GST Council (Article 279A).
events.detail:
One-nation-one-tax; concurrent taxing power for the Union & States.

**Exam hooks:** 101st Amendment (2016) → GST rollout 1 July 2017.

events.title: Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor
events.summary: First phase of the East Coast Economic Corridor (ADB lead partner).
events.detail:
India's first coastal economic corridor; aligned with the Golden Quadrilateral.

**Exam hooks:** VCIC = ECEC phase-1; ADB partner.

events.title: Demonetisation of ₹500 & ₹1000 notes
events.summary: High-value notes withdrawn to curb black money & counterfeiting; push to digital.
events.detail:
Upheld by the SC (Jan 2023) as within the government's power.

**Exam hooks:** demonetisation 8 Nov 2016; boosted UPI/digital payments.

events.title: Insolvency & Bankruptcy Code, 2016
events.summary: Unified, time-bound framework to resolve corporate insolvency.
events.detail:
NCLT adjudicates; improved ease-of-doing-business ranking.

**Exam hooks:** IBC (2016); resolution vs liquidation.

events.title: Inflation-targeting framework (MPC)
events.summary: RBI adopts a 4% (±2%) CPI target; Monetary Policy Committee created.
events.detail:
Statutory MPC under the RBI Act amendment.

**Exam hooks:** flexible inflation targeting; repo rate as the policy tool.

events.title: Startup India launched
events.summary: Ecosystem push for startups — funding, tax breaks, ease of compliance.
events.detail:
Complements Make in India & Digital India.

**Exam hooks:** Startup India (2016); India = 3rd-largest startup ecosystem.

events.title: UPI transforms digital payments
events.summary: NPCI's Unified Payments Interface enables instant mobile payments.
events.detail:
Now the world's largest real-time payments system.

**Exam hooks:** UPI (2016) by NPCI; boosted after demonetisation.

events.title: GST rolled out — "One Nation, One Tax"
events.summary: Goods & Services Tax subsumes most indirect taxes nationwide.
events.detail:
GST Council (Art. 279A) sets rates; multiple slabs (0/5/12/18/28).

**Exam hooks:** rollout 1 July 2017; CGST/SGST/IGST structure.

events.title: Puttaswamy — Right to Privacy
events.summary: 9-judge bench declares privacy a Fundamental Right under Article 21.
events.detail:
Overruled ADM Jabalpur; underpins the Aadhaar and data-protection debates.

**Exam hooks:** privacy = intrinsic to life & liberty (Art. 21).

events.title: Triple Talaq struck down (Shayara Bano)
events.summary: SC voids instant triple talaq; law criminalising it follows in 2019.
events.detail:
Grounded in Articles 14 & 21.

**Exam hooks:** Shayara Bano (2017); Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act 2019.

events.title: 102nd Amendment — constitutional status to NCBC
events.summary: National Commission for Backward Classes gets constitutional status (Art. 338B).
events.detail:
Parallel to NCSC/NCST commissions.

**Exam hooks:** 102nd (2018) → NCBC; 105th (2021) restored states' power to make OBC lists.

events.title: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) launched
events.summary: World's largest health-assurance scheme — ₹5 lakh cover per family.
events.detail:
Plus Health & Wellness Centres.

**Exam hooks:** PM-JAY (2018); ~50 crore beneficiaries.

events.title: Navtej Johar — decriminalising Section 377
events.summary: SC reads down Section 377; consensual same-sex relations decriminalised.
events.detail:
Affirmed dignity and equality under Articles 14, 15, 21.

**Exam hooks:** Navtej Singh Johar (2018).

events.title: 103rd Amendment — 10% EWS reservation
events.summary: Introduces reservation for Economically Weaker Sections; upheld in 2022.
events.detail:
First reservation on purely economic criteria.

**Exam hooks:** 103rd (2019) upheld by SC in Janhit Abhiyan (2022).

events.title: Abrogation of Article 370
events.summary: J&K special status revoked; state reorganised into two UTs.
events.detail:
Upheld by the SC in December 2023.

**Exam hooks:** Art. 370 (temporary); J&K & Ladakh became UTs.

events.title: PM-KISAN income support launched
events.summary: ₹6,000/year direct income support to farmer families.
events.detail:
Direct Benefit Transfer in three instalments.

**Exam hooks:** PM-KISAN (2019); DBT to farmers.

events.title: Three-capital proposal
events.summary: AP proposes Visakhapatnam (executive), Amaravati (legislative), Kurnool (judicial).
events.detail:
Contested in courts; later reversed, restoring Amaravati as sole capital.

**Exam hooks:** three-capital debate (2020) → Amaravati-only restoration (2024–26).

events.title: COVID-19 pandemic
events.summary: WHO declares a pandemic; global lockdowns; India's vaccine drive.
events.detail:
Accelerated digital adoption & telemedicine.

**Exam hooks:** COVID-19 (2020); Covaxin (Bharat Biotech) & Covishield.

events.title: National Education Policy 2020
events.summary: Replaces the 1986 policy; 5+3+3+4 structure; mother-tongue instruction.
events.detail:
Targets 6% of GDP on education.

**Exam hooks:** NEP 2020; Kasturirangan committee.

events.title: AP reorganised into 26 districts
events.summary: District count raised from 13 to 26 for better administration.
events.detail:
New districts aligned largely with Lok Sabha constituencies.

**Exam hooks:** 13 → 26 districts (4 April 2022); later 28 (end-2025).

events.title: INS Vikrant — first indigenous aircraft carrier
events.summary: India commissions its first home-built aircraft carrier.
events.detail:
Boosted self-reliance in defence (Atmanirbhar Bharat).

**Exam hooks:** INS Vikrant (IAC-1); built at Cochin Shipyard.

events.title: 106th Amendment — Women's Reservation
events.summary: Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam — 33% seats for women in Lok Sabha & Assemblies.
events.detail:
Implementation tied to delimitation & census.

**Exam hooks:** 106th Amendment (2023) = one-third women's reservation.

events.title: Aditya-L1 solar mission launched
events.summary: India's first dedicated solar observatory at the L1 point.
events.detail:
Studies the solar corona & solar wind.

**Exam hooks:** Aditya-L1 (2023) at Sun-Earth Lagrange-1.

events.title: Chandrayaan-3 lands near the lunar south pole
events.summary: India becomes the first country to soft-land near the Moon's south pole.
events.detail:
Vikram lander & Pragyan rover; 23 Aug = National Space Day.

**Exam hooks:** Chandrayaan-3 (2023); Aditya-L1 solar mission followed.

events.title: India hosts the G20 Summit (New Delhi)
events.summary: India's G20 presidency; African Union admitted as a member.
events.detail:
Theme "Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam"; Delhi Declaration.

**Exam hooks:** G20 New Delhi (2023); AU joins the G20.

events.title: SSLV maiden success
events.summary: Small Satellite Launch Vehicle for on-demand small-payload launches.
events.detail:
Targets the commercial small-satellite market.

**Exam hooks:** SSLV complements PSLV/GSLV/LVM3.

events.title: Swarna Andhra Vision @2047
events.summary: AP's long-term development vision aligned with India@2047.
events.detail:
Targets growth, e-governance and regional balance.

**Exam hooks:** Swarna Andhra @2047 — state vision document.

events.title: Visakhapatnam as AP's financial/IT hub
events.summary: Vizag emerges as residuary AP's largest commercial & IT centre.
events.detail:
De facto financial capital after the loss of Hyderabad.

**Exam hooks:** Visakhapatnam — largest city & commercial hub of AP.

events.title: AP reorganised into 28 districts
events.summary: District count rises to 28 (Polavaram & Markapuram carved out), w.e.f. 31 Dec 2025.
